fields.audience_description: Existing Internet customers who do not yet have Xfinity Mobile

brief: Cross-sell Xfinity Mobile to existing Internet customers.
note: Agent 3's read probe (probeSchemas + findExistingSegment) must ask the union schema view and list segments, and must never issue a destructive/update write during the probe phase. adobe_create_segment is allowed in Agent 3's overall allowlist but is NOT part of this read probe, so it should not appear here.
